## E-two — Competitive teardown

No competitor product covering Hawaii the unattended-child law, safe backing, entering traffic from driveways and parking positions, roundabouts, choosing and changing lanes, keeping a safe speed and following interval, turns and curves, overtaking and passing, passing parked cars, stopping in traffic, use of brakes and downshifting was reviewed, so this teardown names no rival, quotes no price, compares no structure and records no praise or complaint.

The adopt-and-beat analysis of the master template is explicitly out of scope for this handbook-section dossier; a future market pass with its own sources would own it.

Pedagogy, practice-item and coverage comparison tables are therefore absent by explicit scope choice, not by omission.

Disposition: teardown for this section is present as an explicit scoped statement, not as researched competitive evidence.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the unattended-child law, safe backing, entering traffic from driveways and parking positions, roundabouts, choosing and changing lanes, keeping a safe speed and following interval, turns and curves, overtaking and passing, passing parked cars, stopping in traffic, use of brakes and downshifting rules on pages 64–70 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
